meta.note: Rule rows (PWC25 shape): id, world, statement, locators, speaker, mechanism, derives. Derived values cite a rule id (PWC20). Proposals, agent-written inference; no canon line states this rule.

rules.statement: A potion's effect comes from what goes into it, so an ingredient carries the effect axes of the potions it is brewed in: support for an axis is the share of its recipes (with a known effect) that name it, weaker when there is one recipe; the same thing in another form (dittany leaf, essence of dittany) and, at a lower weight, other parts of the same source creature or plant lend the axes a source states for them. A derived set says an axis is present at trace or some, never strong, and a stated axis from a later wiki or chapter pass replaces it. Default: the authored effect-to-axis map in scripts/derive_hp_properties.mjs; dials: minimum confidence 0.25, cap 0.8, stem weights 0.55 and 0.3; reason: a recipe's effect is known more often than its ingredients' properties (R5: 13 of 117 stated in the novels).
rules.speaker: inference (agent proposal, PWC22); not stated in a source
rules.mechanism: src/hp_property_set.js (material row, derived case) + src/brew_dose_response.js (dose law)
